instruction: Find an arXiv paper about 'Alpaca' language models published in 2023 and add it to row 3 of the spreadsheet, ensuring all three columns (title, arXiv link, and publication date) are properly filled.

parameters.window_name: New Large Language Models.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding an Alpaca paper and adding it to row 3 with complete information. The evaluator retrieves row 3 data and verifies: (1) Column A contains 'Alpaca' (case-insensitive), (2) Column B contains an arXiv URL with 'arxiv.org', (3) Column C contains '2023'. Partial credit of 0.33 per correct column, 1.0 if all requirements are met.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all three instruction requirements
Metric checks column A (title) contains 'Alpaca' using case-insensitive search
Metric checks column B (link) contains 'arxiv.org' to verify it's an arXiv paper

Metric checks column C (date) contains '2023' to verify publication year
Proper partial credit scoring: 0.33 + 0.34 + 0.33 = 1.0 for all requirements met
Getter correctly extracts row 3 data from the spreadsheet using openpyxl
Postconfig ensures file is saved before getter reads it
Complete coverage: All instruction requirements are verified
